name: Q00/ouroboros
summary: Specification-first workflow runtime for Codex and other coding agents that turns ambiguity-scored Socratic interviews into immutable Seeds, then decomposes their acceptance criteria and evaluates execution with mechanical checks, semantic review, and optional multi-model consensus over event-sourced, resumable state.
evidence: The `ooo auto` workflow interviews the user, generates a Seed, and applies a readiness grade before handing the Seed to a coding-agent runtime.
Seeds preserve goals, constraints, ontology, and acceptance criteria in a frozen schema; criteria can carry stable semantic keys, verification commands, expected artifacts, and output assertions.

The default execution harness decomposes acceptance criteria for parallel execution, grounds completion claims in runtime events and workspace artifacts, and routes failed verification through retry or escalation paths.

Post-execution evaluation combines mechanical checks with semantic assessment of acceptance-criterion compliance, goal alignment, drift, and reward-hacking risk, with multi-model consensus available for triggered cases.
The project ships dedicated Codex setup, skills, rules, MCP integration, runtime handling, and session-resume support.
